meta.title: Closed beta | IGUDAR
meta.description: A closed test of the IGUDAR platform with about 50 people, using demo money only. Apply for the beta and tell us what works.

hero.title: Try IGUDAR with demo money.
hero.lede: We are testing the platform with about 50 people. Explore properties, simulate a subscription from {amount} and tell us what works. No real money is involved.
hero.rosetteLabel: Demo money. Nothing real at stake.

approve.title: A founder approves by hand
approve.body: Every application is read by a person.

access.title: You get the email with your access

what.title: What the beta is
what.lede: A small, honest test of the real platform. We want to see whether the rules, the numbers and the screens make sense to the people they are built for, before anything is offered to the public.

closed.title: A closed test
closed.body: About 50 people, let in by hand. A founder approves every account before you get in.

demo.title: Demo money only
demo.body: Every subscription uses demo money. No real money is collected or moved, anywhere in the beta.

clock.title: Time can run faster
clock.body: The simulation may run faster than real time: up to a year of activity in about two weeks. You will always see which mode is on.

who.title: Who it is for
who.lede: Urban professionals in Morocco and Moroccans abroad who are curious about owning a share of a rented building, and who want to read the rules before any real money is involved.
who.dataBody: To learn what works, we record how you use the beta (usage events) and the feedback you give us. No identity documents are stored. Your data is handled under Moroccan personal-data law (Law 09-08), overseen by the CNDP. You will see a consent screen before you start.

explore.title: Explore properties
explore.body: Read the documents, the fees and the risks of each demo property.

simulate.title: Simulate subscriptions
simulate.body: Subscribe with demo money, from {amount} per property, and see where it sits.

receive.title: Receive simulated distributions
receive.body: Watch simulated rent arrive, net of fees and taxes, as the clock moves.

feedback.title: Tell us what works
feedback.body: Say what was clear, what was confusing and what you would change.

apply.title: Apply for the beta
apply.lede: We ask a few questions so we can choose a mix of people and learn from each of them. It takes about a minute. A founder reads every answer.

access.title: Prefer to go straight in?
access.body: Create an account on the platform. You will read and accept the beta consent first, then a founder approves your access by hand.

fields.ticketBucket: What would you realistically consider, per property?
fields.ticketHint: This only helps us understand the range. The beta uses demo money.
fields.experience: Your experience with property or savings products

experience.some: Some experience (savings products, a rental, or a first look)
experience.experienced: Experienced (I own or invest in property or funds)

form.consent: I agree that IGUDAR may store these answers and my email to review my application and contact me about the closed beta. I understand the beta uses demo money.
form.next: Next: a founder reads your application by hand and writes to you by email.
